title: Mazda灯维护要点
content: Mazda灯不要在冷却状态下清洁；震动大的位置应加装减震器；断丝可轻摇灯使断端接触，通电后电流会将其焊合。
quote: It is best not to clean Mazda lamps when cold. Shock absorbers should be used where there is much jarring.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: Mazda灯组启动冲击
content: 一组Mazda灯接通瞬间会出现过大电流，配电与开关选型需考虑这一瞬时冲击。
quote: When a bank of Mazda lamps is turned on there is an excessive current for an instant.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 电极须磨尖
content: 上下电极都要磨尖，尤其是下电极；下电极不磨尖会遮挡弧坑发出的光，影响画面亮度。
quote: Always point your electrodes, especially the lower. If the lower electrode is not pointed, it will interfere with the light of the crater.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 电极尺寸按电流选
content: 上电极常用5/8英寸、下电极常用1/2英寸，具体取决于所用电流；电极过大时电弧会绕外侧游走，造成光线差且不均匀。
quote: The recommendations for sizes of upper and lower electrodes vary somewhat but run mostly to 5/8 inch for upper and 1/2 inch for lower.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 串联弧光灯隔离易燃物
content: 串联弧光灯必须与易燃材料仔细隔离，避免长时间高温引燃布景。
keywords: 串联弧光灯隔离易燃物
quote: Must be carefully isolated from inflammable material.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 交流弧双弧坑易致双光斑
content: 交流弧有两个弧坑，若想同时利用两坑的光，电极必须对得极准；稍有偏差就会出现双光斑，且银幕中心照度不足。多数操作者最终会放弃双坑取光，改用图7A式设定。
quote: If the electrodes are not set exactly right, we may get a double spot and poor illumination at the center of the screen.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 交流弧噪声与频率
content: 交流弧比直流弧噪声大得多，但在很高频率下这种噪声会消失。
quote: The alternating-current arc is much noisier than the direct-current arc, but with very high frequencies this noise ceases.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 通外门设门斗
content: 从舞台通往室外的门应设门斗，以防风把帷幕吹乱，并避免演员受穿堂风干扰。
quote: The vestibule prevents the wind from blowing the drapery about unduly and also shields the actors from unpleasant drafts.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 交流用有芯碳棒
content: 使用交流电时必须选用有芯碳棒（cored carbons），以保证电弧稳定。
quote: Always use cored carbons for alternating current.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 固定弧光灯用于外景
content: 剧场固定安装的弧光灯多用于室外照明，常在观众厅前部成组布置两盏以上，采用火焰弧光灯型并高悬安装。
quote: Permanently located arc lamps are used about theaters mostly for out-door lighting.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 台口上方排灯布光
content: 可在台口开口正上方的脚手架上成排布置小型透镜灯，某知名制作即用十二盏此类灯。
quote: In one well-known production twelve such lamps were used upon scaffolding directly above the proscenium opening.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 台口侧灯位置取舍
content: 台口侧灯置于钢幕两侧，有时装在观众席一侧以尽量前移；但该位置角度别扭，难以把光打向有用方向，需权衡。
quote: The location of these lights is awkward and it is difficult to get light from them in a useful direction.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 同回路导线同管敷设
content: 同一回路或同一系统的干线、支线所有导线必须穿在同一根管内；分开敷设会造成不必要的电压降并导致线管发热。
quote: All wires of any circuit or mains or sub-mains of any system must be run in the same conduit.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 下电极前移的取舍
content: 图7A式设定中两电极均倾斜、下电极略前于上电极，可把上电极弧坑向前拉、改善聚光镜受光；但前移过度时下电极会遮挡透镜下部，因此下电极必须始终让聚光镜各部分都能直接收到上电极弧坑的光。
quote: The lower electrode must always be set so that it allows all parts of the condenser to receive direct rays of light from the crater of the upper.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 飞絮环境全封闭灯罩
content: 在易燃料飞絮环境中使用弧光灯时，须把电极完全封在密闭灯罩内，从而免装火花罩。
quote: must have the electrodes enclosed completely in a tight globe in such manner as to avoid the necessity for spark arresters.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 易燃处加防火花罩
content: 在易燃物附近使用开放式弧光灯时，必须加装火花消除器。
quote: Provide spark arresters for all open-arc lamps in the vicinity of inflammable material.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 外罩脏污影响
content: 外罩脏污既影响观感又吸收光线，布光前应清洁外罩，避免亮度损失。
quote: A dirty globe looks very unsightly and absorbs much light.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧光灯悬挂高度
content: 室外弧光灯须悬于人行道上方至少8英尺；室内弧光灯须置于够不到处或加适当防护。
quote: Outside arc lamps must be suspended at least eight feet above sidewalks. Inside arc lamps must be placed out of reach or suitably protected.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧光灯内罩清洁
content: 封闭式弧光灯的内罩若积存杂质会吸收大量光线，须定期清洁内罩以维持出光效率。
quote: impurities are cast off which soon coat the inner globe and absorb much of the light.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 磁铁偏吹弧光
content: 将磁铁靠近电弧可将其吹灭或推向一侧，这一原理被用于某些避雷器中。
quote: A magnet held close to an arc can be made to blow it out or force it to one side. This fact is made use of in some lightning arresters.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 小规格用螺钉垫圈接线
content: 小规格开关端子采用螺钉加垫圈、端子带上翘接线耳的连接方式，可获得可靠接触。
quote: For the smaller sizes, a screw and washer connection with up-turned lugs on the switch terminal gives a satisfactory contact.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 可调电阻随手可及
content: 应始终把可调电阻放在手边，以便按不同胶片或幻灯灯调整电流。
quote: An adjustable resistance should always be kept in reach so that the current may be varied to suit different films or stereopticon lamps.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧光灯不宜做舞台面光
content: 廉价剧场在舞台上用一对弧光灯效果不佳：光不均匀、不稳定，且无法正常调光，故舞台照明不宜采用弧光灯。
quote: The light is not even and steady enough and cannot be properly “dimmed”.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧光灯裸露件绝缘
content: 弧光灯所有裸露金属部件必须与电路可靠绝缘，避免演职人员触碰带电部位。
quote: All exposed parts must be carefully insulated from the circuit.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧光灯防碳棒坠落
content: 弧光灯须装可靠止挡，防止灯夹松动时碳棒掉落砸到下方人员或布景。
quote: Must be provided with reliable stops to prevent carbons from falling out in case the clamps become loose.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 火花罩封住灯罩上口
content: 弧光灯须装火花罩，把灯罩上口封到碳棒火花无法逸出的程度，防止火花落到布景或演员身上。
quote: Spark arresters must so close the upper orifice of the globe that it will be impossible for any sparks, thrown off by the carbons, to escape.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 放映机位预留弧光灯插座
content: 当放映机需要架设在楼座（gallery）时，应在该处预留弧光灯插座，避免临时拉线；插座位置随放映机位一并规划。
quote: Pockets for arc lamps are often provided, as it often happens that a moving-picture machine must be placed in the gallery.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 恒压灯需限流电阻
content: 恒压灯电路中必须有限流电阻，电阻可置于灯内或灯外。
quote: Constant-potential lamps cannot be operated without resistance in the circuit; this resistance may be in the lamp itself or outside.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 恒流灯不可开路
content: 恒流（串联）灯线路绝不能断开，若要切除某灯须用分流方式绕过该灯。
quote: With constant-current or series lamps, the line must never be opened, but must be shunted around the lamp if a lamp is to be cut out.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧灯须专人看管
content: 所有便携式舞台灯均为手动进碳，需要操作员全程密切注意；串联高压工况下更难起弧，须按专门方法处理。
quote: All portable stage lamps are hand feed and require close attention on the part of operators.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 双极开关控制
content: 所有灯具都应使用双极开关控制，以保证两极同时切断。
quote: In all cases each lamp should be controlled by a double pole switch.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 螺丝定期润滑
content: 所有螺丝与调节部件应经常充分润滑，因为灯箱内高温会很快蒸发掉润滑油。
quote: All of the screws and adjustments should be well lubricated frequently. The heat in the lamp house soon evaporates all lubrication.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 断碳棒先开槽
content: 折断碳棒电极前先在其上开一个小槽，以便干净折断。
quote: Notch the carbon electrode a little before attempting to break it off.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 煤气灯与电灯不得同具
content: 按国家电气规程，除摩擦式系统外，电点火煤气灯不得与电灯装在同一灯具上，布光时须把两类光源分开设置。
quote: Electric gas lighting, unless it is the frictional system, must not be used on the same fixtures with the electric light.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 舞台用手动弧灯
content: 按操作方式弧灯分手动进给与自动进给两类；舞台照明实际只允许使用手动进给弧灯。
quote: The hand-feed lamp is generally used in theaters and is practically the only kind admitted on the stage, or for stage illuminating purposes.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 高压灯绝缘操作
content: 操作高压灯前须与地面绝缘，接触带电导线时一次只用一只手。
quote: Never handle high tension lamps without insulating yourself from the ground; and handle live wires only with one hand at a time.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 电极选用与极性
content: 正极比负极保温更久；电极的质量与尺寸直接影响运行，应始终使用灯具厂商推荐的电极。
quote: The positive electrode retains heat longer than the negative. The quality and size of electrodes has much to do with successful operation.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 每灯独立保险与开关
content: 每盏灯应配各自的保险丝与开关，便于单独断电与保护。
quote: Each lamp should be provided with its own fuses and switch.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 过道灯独立回路
content: 沿台阶与过道布置的过道灯只照地面，应接独立回路，并在门口设开关控制，便于散场与引导。
quote: Aisle lights should be arranged on a separate circuit and controlled by a switch at the door.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 多股线须用接线端子
content: 灯具内、开关处与变阻器处的所有多股绞合连接必须配经认可的接线端子（lugs）。
quote: All stranded connections in lamp and at switch and rheostat must be provided with approved lugs.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 易燃环境加金属网罩
content: 灯具附近有易燃料时，须在玻璃罩外加网孔不超过1.25英寸的金属网和合格火花罩，防止碳或熔铜火花逸出。
quote: Must be provided with a wire netting (having a mesh not exceeding one and one-fourth inches) around the globe and an approved spark arrester

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 煤气线路接地报警
content: 煤气灯线路与煤气管共走易发生接地，应加装电铃与电池作接地指示：一旦接地造成持续电流，火花线圈吸动衔铁使铃持续鸣响，便于在演出前发现故障。
quote: If a ground causes a continuous current, the spark coil will attract the armature, thus causing the bell to ring continuously.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 串联电阻降压计算
content: 用串联电阻降压时，压降=电流×电阻；例如110V电路驱动45V、25A的弧灯，需电阻2.6Ω（25×2.6=65V压降，余45V给弧灯）。
quote: The drop in voltage is equal to the current multiplied by the resistance

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 自动煤气应急灯的点火机构
content: 用煤气做应急照明时，可在每个煤气喷口装电磁铁：通电时既开气又打火，也可反向关气；系统需配大容量电池与火花线圈，并设开、关两个按钮。
quote: At each gas jet a magnet _M_ is installed which, when energized, is capable of turning the gas on and at the same time producing a spark.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 电极须垂直面对齐
content: 电极必须在垂直平面内完全对齐（如图7B），否则燃烧过程中弧光会漂移，导致画面照度不稳。
quote: The electrode must align perfectly in the vertical plane as shown in _B_, Figure 7, or the arc will move while burning.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 串联电阻防短路
content: 电极接触或间距极小时，须在电路中串联电阻（交流弧用电抗器）限制电流，否则起弧瞬间会短路。
quote: some resistance, or reactance in the case of alternating-current arcs, is always connected in series in the circuit.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 间距过大的后果
content: 电极间距继续拉大，电弧会变长并出现火焰状，最终完全断裂熄灭。
quote: If the separation be carried still further, the arc will grow longer and become flaming until finally it breaks entirely.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 白光与彩色灯数量相等
content: 白光灯的数量通常等于所有彩色灯的总数，用于平衡色彩布光。
quote: The number of white lights is usually equal to that of all of the colors.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧光灯需降压供电
content: 直流弧灯最佳工作电压为45–50V，交流弧灯为30–40V；而市电配电多为110V或220V（偶达550V），因此必须在电路中串接降压装置才能让弧灯正常工作。
quote: The direct-current arc requires for its best operation a voltage of from 45 to 50, while the alternating-current arc uses from 30 to 40.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 观众席禁用弧光灯
content: 礼堂/观众席照明优先用高效白炽灯，不推荐装弧光灯；弧光灯唯一优势是布线初成本低，但高位灯具的修剪维护困难会抵消这点。
quote: In the auditorium, arc lamps are sometimes installed, but this practice can not be recommended

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧形脚灯贴近观众
content: 脚灯沿舞台前缘排成与观众席同向的弧线，使演员能更靠近观众、声音更易传达，同时弧线布光比直线更能照亮演员侧面。
quote: If then the stage and foot lights are curved in the same way, the actors will be able to come that much closer to the audience

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 自动弧灯用途
content: 自动进给弧灯如今主要用于剧场外立面照明，而非舞台内照明。
quote: At the present time these are used mostly, if at all, for the illumination of the exterior of the theater.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 舞台侧不设总开关
content: 舞台侧灯光接另一组汇流排，但不宜由单一总开关整体控制；否则暗场时切断全部后重新给光，可能残留上一场布光而干扰新场。
quote: it is best not to have the stage side of the board as a whole controlled by a main switch.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 舞台插座藏于布景后
content: 舞台插座应离舞台中心足够远，确保始终位于布景之后；若太靠近中心，在全景布景中可能被观众看见。
quote: The stage pockets are laid out far enough from the center of the stage to insure their being always behind the scenery.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 舞台灯分四组
content: 舞台灯光通常分为四组：三个颜色组加一组舞台地排灯（pockets）。
quote: The stage lighting is usually divided into four groups, viz.: three color groups and a group of stage pockets.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 舞台用弧灯选型
content: 舞台照明优先选用开放式弧灯（open arc），封闭式弧灯电压高、剧场少用；开放式弧灯几乎只用于舞台。
quote: The open arc is almost universally used for stage work and this is about the only place where it is still considered useful.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 舞台弧光灯的防护要求
content: 若必须在舞台上布置弧光灯，须将其悬吊于布景之间并用金属丝护罩包住；部分城市禁止在舞台上方悬吊弧光灯。
quote: they must be suspended amid the scenery and enclosed with wire guards.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 上投阴影判倒装
content: 若阴影强烈向上投射，说明灯被倒装使用，应调整灯位。
quote: Strong shadows cast upwards indicate a lamp burning “upside down”.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 支架开关防误触
content: 装在支架上的开关须做成无法意外触碰任何带电部位的结构。
quote: Switch on standard must be so constructed that accidental contact with any live portion of same will be impossible.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 起弧需先接触电极
content: 要形成电弧，必须先把两电极接触以启动电流，再缓慢分开电极使电流穿过间隙，产生约3500℃高温并挥发碳极材料。
quote: In order that an arc may be formed, it is necessary first to bring the electrodes together.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 观众席灯单开关控制
content: 观众席（厅内）照明应全部经由一个总开关供电，便于统一开关。
quote: All of the house lights should be fed through one main switch

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 小开关可用重型线夹
content: 较小规格的开关可用简单线夹，但须足够厚重以承受频繁使用。
quote: For the smaller sized switches simple clamps can be employed, provided they are heavy enough to stand considerable hard usage.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 聚光灯的三种机位
content: 透镜式聚光灯（spot/lens lamp）用于舞台、天桥以及“前区”（front，指楼座/廊台区域）三个位置打光，可配可拆卸的Sciopticon附件做投影效果。
quote: This style of lamp is used on the stage, on bridges, or “in front”

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 透镜灯可密闭
content: 透镜灯（lens lamp）可完全密闭，因为除穿过前方透镜的光外不需要其他光线外泄。
quote: Lens lamps can be tightly enclosed since none of the light is wanted except that which passes through the lens in front.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 配电盘位置与视线
content: 配电盘多设在舞台右侧面向观众处，便于舞台监督与电工配合；应抬高或嵌入台口墙，使操作者始终能看清舞台，因为许多灯光提示来自演员走位。
quote: He should have a full view of the stage at all times, since many of his cues are given by movements of the actors.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 配电盘抬高避免占台
content: 配电盘应抬高到舞台面以上，使舞台地面全部可供演员使用；若置于台面高度会占用宝贵空间并妨碍演员上下场。
quote: It is preferable to have the board raised high enough above stage level to allow all space on the stage to be used by actors.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 弧灯可用白炽灯仿制
content: 需要弧灯外观但不用真弧灯时，可用白炽灯置于合适球形罩内、灯罩做成弧灯外形来仿制。
quote: Arc lamps are often imitated by an incandescent lamp placed within a suitable globe with the hood made up in the shape of an arc lamp.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Operation, Stage Electrics and Illusions
source_ref.author: Henry Charles Horstmann

title: 淡入淡出如舞台幕布
content: fade（淡入淡出）效果的用法类似舞台幕布，用来开启和关闭场景。
quote: The "fade" effects are used very much as the curtain of the legitimate stage is used to open and close scenes.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 景别术语定义
content: “LONG SHOT”（远景）与“CLOSE-UP”（特写）指摄影机与被摄场景之间的距离。
quote: The terms "LONG SHOT" and "CLOSE-UP" refer to the distance at which the camera is placed from the scene.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 单本戏场景数量
content: 一本（one reel）内场景数不固定，取决于各场长度，平均约35至40场；短促的闪现场景可以很多，模型剧本可超过40场。
quote: The average is between thirty-five and forty.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 叙事优先于纯动作
content: 不要只展示动作场面，应让画面承担讲故事的功能；实践表明有情节的故事片最受各地观众欢迎。
quote: Reynaud was not content to show merely scenes of action but wished to tell a story.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 临时幕布选材
content: 临时性放映的幕布可用建筑师描图布（tracing cloth）替代，作为低成本、易得的临时成像面。
quote: If it is to be used only temporarily, the tracing cloth used by architects is a very satisfactory material.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 媒介限制即创作前提
content: 为银幕写故事时，先承认媒介自带的限制与约束；连续性编剧虽比诗人、小说家拥有更多调度自由，但必须按银幕媒介的规则取舍，不能照搬文学叙事手法。
quote: he is also bound by limitations and restrictions inherent in the medium through which he is working as a raconteur

source_ref.title: That Marvel—The Movie A Glance at Its Past, Its Promising Present and Its Significant Future
source_ref.author: Van Zile, Edward S. (Edward Sims), 1863-1931; Hays, Will H. (Will Harrison), 1879-1954 [Author of introduction, etc.]; Pyle, Howard, 1853-1911 [Illustrator]

title: 剧场式舞台设施
content: 从摄影机位看过去，舞台应具备侧幕、吊景等剧场设施，便于按戏剧方式调度演员与布景。
quote: Looking into the studio from this point, one saw a familiar theatre stage, with wings, flies, and other facilities.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 体格气质需经试镜检验
content: 体格与气质在镜头前可能完全反转：战场英雄在试镜片中被投射成贫血、柔弱的形象，因此角色气质必须通过试镜片验证，不能凭现实印象判断。
quote: he appeared as an anæmic, effeminate stripling, whose every gesture aroused the ridicule of the audience

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 远去的列车与取物
content: 先拍列车在远处驶离，再让角色入画从电线杆上拔下钉子，用远近对比交代时间差与行动。
quote: Receding train in distance. Black Jack comes on, yanks spike from post.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 银幕叙事的必然性分级
content: 写分镜/剧本时，把故事归入不可能、或然、必然三类；银幕观众已不易被糊弄，能分辨鹰与鹭，因此情节走向应落在'必然'一侧，靠因果逻辑而非巧合推进。
quote: any given novel must be placed in the category of either the Impossible, the Improbable or the Inevitable

source_ref.title: That Marvel—The Movie A Glance at Its Past, Its Promising Present and Its Significant Future
source_ref.author: Van Zile, Edward S. (Edward Sims), 1863-1931; Hays, Will H. (Will Harrison), 1879-1954 [Author of introduction, etc.]; Pyle, Howard, 1853-1911 [Illustrator]

title: 场景表标注使用次数
content: 写场景表时，每个地点后标注该地点在剧本中被使用的场次编号，便于统计同一场景的复用与拍摄安排。
quote: [The figures denote the number of the scenes in which the different locations are used. List every location or setting used in this scene plot.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 分镜编剧的职责
content: 分镜/连续性编剧负责把故事转成画面形式，赋予其银幕价值；导演拿到分镜后才开始拍摄。
quote: The scenario writer puts the story into picture form exactly as a dramatist may put a novel into play form for the stage.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 对白用SP标记
content: 分镜剧本中角色说出的台词以"SP:"前缀加引号标出，与动作描述行区分开，便于识别可听信息与可见动作。
quote: SP: "GOOD-BY, DOCTOR."

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 导演先定动作后放权
content: 初期导演会替演员设计好每一处动作，演员先照做；待机会到来时演员须能独立"创造角色"，因此要随时准备接管动作设计。
quote: Perhaps at first the director will never give you a chance to do a piece of original acting. He will work out every bit of action for you.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 场景的划分标准
content: 判断是否要另起一场戏，看摄影机是否需要停机并移动机位：若下一动作需要停机移机才能拍到，就应编为新的场号；一场戏定义为不停机可拍完的动作。
quote: “a scene is the action that can be photographed without stopping the camera.”

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 用旅行反应看投入度
content: 判断演员对电影的投入程度，可观察其在旅行等非拍摄场景中的反应：离开片场便若有所失者投入度高，而对外界兴致勃勃者则说明银幕并未占满其全部精力。
quote: often they really seemed lost without their pictures.

source_ref.title: Behind the Screen
source_ref.author: Goldwyn, Samuel, 1879-1974

title: 剧本首页与封面信息
content: 剧本可用外页写片名、本数、喜剧或正剧类型、作者姓名地址；正文首页左上角写作者姓名与地址，随后是片名与故事梗概。
quote: The first page proper of your scenario will read:

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 逐场写动作的剧本格式
content: 剧本（scenario）按场逐场展开故事，每场写明角色所做的每一个动作，并可在结构要点处加注说明。
quote: the beginner will understand the manner in which he must develop his story, scene by scene, telling of each move made by the characters.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 高点隐蔽埋伏
content: 匪徒到达伏击地点后，让他们分散隐蔽在有利位置（制高点、掩体后），用位置关系暗示即将发生的袭击。
quote: Four bandits arrive, conceal themselves at points of vantage.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 分头行动的调度
content: 反派下令后，让四名手下从左侧出画、首领与另一人从右侧出画，用左右分头出画交代多线行动。
quote: At his last word four desperados exit left. Black Jack and Bird Stevens go off right.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 先侦察后行动
content: 反派接近目标前，先给一个观察镜头（在对面树林窥视、确认无人），再切到他们穿越或进入，用两步动作建立紧张。
quote: Black Jack and Bird take observations; way is clear; start across.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 同一场景复用布景
content: 同一地点反复出现时，分镜标注沿用同一场景编号与布景（如“as in 18”“as in 8”），保证空间连续、可复用搭景。
quote: _Exterior of station, as in 18._

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 放大视点插入的重复使用
content: 同一放大镜视点可在片中多次插入：清空第二舞台后重摆道具，再次近距直拍，表现烟灰中精灵大笑奔跑。
quote: The second stage is cleared again, and we see the man empty the ashes of his pipe upon the table.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 各艺术门类手法不可通用
content: 同一故事在不同媒介中允许的自由度不同：诗体叙事可取小说不能取的自由，银幕叙事又有其专属特权与禁忌；分镜时按媒介选择叙事手段，不做跨媒介直接移植。
quote: The poet who tells a story in verse may take liberties denied to the novelist relating the same story.

source_ref.title: That Marvel—The Movie A Glance at Its Past, Its Promising Present and Its Significant Future
source_ref.author: Van Zile, Edward S. (Edward Sims), 1863-1931; Hays, Will H. (Will Harrison), 1879-1954 [Author of introduction, etc.]; Pyle, Howard, 1853-1911 [Illustrator]

title: 替身保档
content: 同一镜头反复重拍时，可安排另一名演员随时顶替当晚演出，避免主演因连续重拍而无法完成既定场次。
quote: you must have another actor handy to go on for me to-night, for I cannot take any more chances.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 布景与道具储备
content: 因剧情跨越各时代与地域，制片厂须常备大量道具与服装，按国家、民族、时代分类打包标注，做到随时可取用。
quote: a large stock of properties and an extensive wardrobe must be maintained

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 牙齿必须完美
content: 因特写会放大口腔细节，银幕演员的牙齿必须整齐无缺，否则在近景中会破坏形象。
quote: The teeth must be perfect.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 跳拍下的情绪准备
content: 因电影场次几乎不按顺序拍摄（先拍结尾、后拍开头），演员无法靠前序动作自然进入状态，因此开拍前须留出时间通读并体会角色情绪，把情绪提前"预存"，实拍时靠模仿力复现，而非现场重新酝酿。
quote: In the movies the scenes are nearly always taken out of sequence, the first last, the last first, and so forth.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 排练室应对夜雨
content: 在主体建筑内设排练室，供夜间与雨天使用；外景/日光受阻时转排练，保证进度不中断。
quote: An elongated one-story building contained the office, projection room, rehearsal room, for nights and rainy days

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 外景先征得许可
content: 在实景地开机前先找到场地负责人征得拍摄许可，得到否定答复即视为默许，随后再架机拍摄。
quote: We asked him would there be any objection to our working, and he gruffly answered in the negative.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 路标交代地点
content: 在岔路口等场景中，用路牌文字（如“Mason’s Cut, 1 mile”）直接向观众交代地点与距离，省去额外说明镜头。
quote: Four desperados cantering, pass sign-post: “Mason’s Cut, 1 mile.”

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 等待期加小动作
content: 在把人物汇聚到高潮之前的等待段落，给在场角色安排小动作（如听差少年看小说、被扔东西惊起），用细节维持观众兴趣，而不是让角色干坐无事。
quote: The author must hold his audience’s interest while bringing his characters together for the climax.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 缓节奏的过场镜头
content: 在紧张段落之间插入一个静态过场：如守卫坐在门阶上、把步枪横放膝上、悠闲卷烟，用缓慢动作调节节奏。
quote: Close-up of Bird seated on door-step with Winchester across knee. Leisurely rolls cigarette.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 运动车厢内的特写
content: 在行驶的车厢内拍写字特写时，让字迹因车身晃动而显得潦草，以强化运动感与真实感。
quote: Handwriting to be irregular owing to train motion.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 地板标线限定表演区
content: 在表演区两侧地板上铺设压条（batten）标出演员可活动的边界，演员一旦越出该范围就会出画，场务须随时喊话让演员保持在画面内。
quote: On the floor on either side battens are laid to indicate the limits within which actors and actresses must move.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 旋转舞台追日
content: 在露天屋顶拍戏时，把整个舞台架在大型铁转盘上，随太阳方位旋转，使舞台全天朝向阳光。
quote: The whole revolved on a massive iron turn-table so that the stage faced the sun throughout the day.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 内外景标记
content: 场景指示多用大写字母书写；“EXTERIOR”或缩写“EXT.”指户外场景，“INTERIOR”或“INT.”指室内场景。
quote: "EXTERIOR," or the abbreviated "EXT.," for example, refers to a scene outdoors, while "INTERIOR" or "INT.," is an indoor scene.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 按情绪曲线排列场景
content: 场景顺序按情绪曲线安排：先田园劳作与礼拜的宁静，再铁栅窗前的爱情，接山顶丧子的悲恸，最后以庭院婚礼收束。
quote: love scenes at Ramona’s iron-barred window; scenes of heartache on the bleak mountain top

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 外景地建档
content: 外景地需在开拍前确定；导演应勘察影棚周边，用卡片索引把可用作背景的地点（殖民地式老宅、小溪、林荫弯路等）分类存档，以备后续剧本调用。
quote: some even make use of card indexes to catalogue the spots that may be used at some future time as backgrounds for picture scenes

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 现场配乐带情绪
content: 多数制片厂在重要场次拍摄时用小乐队现场演奏：悲情戏配《悲怆奏鸣曲》一类哀伤曲目，喜剧场次配轻快音乐，以帮助演员进入情绪"音高"。
quote: employing small orchestras to play during the important scenes

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 照片用于运动研究
content: 多种装置型号也采用照片而非手绘，便于做色彩与运动再现的研究。
quote: Photographs were also used in various of the Praxinoscope models. It was useful for color research.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 大功率放映用电动发电机组
content: 大规模放映时不要用电阻消耗多余电流，改用电动发电机组：市电驱动电动机，电动机再带动发电机给灯供电，虽绕但省电。
quote: where picture projection is being carried out on a large scale, a motor generator is adopted.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 先看拍戏再学表演
content: 学习电影表演最有效的方法是：在亲自上镜之前，尽可能多地旁观他人拍戏；今日多数明星都是先看别人在镜头前的尝试而习得技艺。
quote: The best way to learn the principles of motion picture acting is to watch the making of as many scenes as possible before attempting to act one.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 按演员类型定拍摄节奏
content: 安排拍摄节奏前先判断演员属于系统型还是冲动型：系统型可固定时段、按计划开工；冲动型不能按钟点排班，应允许其按状态随时进入拍摄，硬套时间表会损耗其表演。
quote: she is a systematised human being who presents in temperament the opposite pole from Mabel Normand. The latter is a creature of impulse.

source_ref.title: Behind the Screen
source_ref.author: Goldwyn, Samuel, 1879-1974

title: 棚内顶光布光法
content: 室内拍摄时，在舞台前上方架设一排强光顶灯（对应剧场顶光），用开关集中控制光量，需要时可将超过8万烛光的光全部打到场景上；另设辅助灯制造不同效果，因此大摄影棚必须配备训练有素的电工班底。
quote: a battery of powerful electric lights is placed overhead in front of the stage, corresponding to theatrical top-lights

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 导演坐椅位置
content: 导演执导时坐在普通厨房椅上，位置在摄影机侧后方一点，而非站在摄影机正后方或画面内。
quote: On an ordinary kitchen chair a bit to one side of the camera, Mr. Griffith usually sat when directing.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 窗光被布景遮挡
content: 少量窗户透进的自然光会被积尘的旧布景挡住，因此布景摆放需考虑对既有窗光的遮挡，不能指望窗光作主光。
quote: What little light came through the few windows was soon blocked by dusty old scenery.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 旋转镜头加滤色片
content: 尝试彩色活动影像时，可用带滤色片的旋转镜头方案；但该做法在当时并未成功，仅作历史参考。
quote: About 1899 he made attempts at color motion pictures, using a rotating lens with a filter, but here again he was unsuccessful.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 布景后置留通道
content: 布景搭在场地后部中央，前方留出可通行的过道空间，避免布景贴门或占满整个棚内。
quote: A “scene” was set back center, just allowing passage room.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 表演须成第二本能
content: 开拍前演员须把角色演到如同第二本能，因为镜头会记录一切：瞟向场外、看导演求指示这类舞台上无碍的小动作都会被拍下，只能重拍。
quote: the players must go through their parts as though they were “second nature,” for the camera registers everything

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 工作台本定拍摄顺序
content: 开拍前须编写工作台本（working script），规定各场戏的实际拍摄顺序，而非按成片顺序。
quote: He must prepare his “working script,” which will outline the order in which he is to produce the different scenes of the story.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 开拍前通读全片排练
content: 开机前由编剧与导演召集全组，逐场朗读剧本并解释每场含义；若条件允许，把全片按场次顺序完整排练一遍再开拍，让演员掌握场次顺序及自己角色与其他角色、与整体的关系。
quote: If the author and director are wise the story is then carefully rehearsed clear through, scene by scene, before anything is photographed.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 用实拍测试灯光
content: 引入电灯照明时，先用动作激烈、反差大的实拍素材（如拳赛）做试验，确认曝光与照度满意后再用于常规剧情拍摄。
quote: satisfactory results first being obtained with the Jeffries-Sharkey prize fight

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 聚光镜集中弧光
content: 弧光灯发出的光在灯箱内是发散的，须用聚光镜把光线汇聚后再投向银幕，否则亮度不足。
quote: it is the purpose of the condensing lenses to concentrate the rays before throwing them on the screen.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 多导演并行分工制
content: 当一家公司同时推进多部类型各异的影片时，可配置多名舞台监督/制片人分头负责，如某公司同时启用八名、另一家六名，以并行提高产量。
quote: the Pathé firm has no less than eight stage managers engaged in the production of picture plays of every description

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 多线并进保持联系
content: 当剧情分处多个地点时，用短切镜头交替展示各条线的推进（如反派向目标移动），让观众始终知道每条线的动向，避免长时间停留在无进展的单一场景。
quote: The audience must now be kept in touch with events happening at different points.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 字幕标示时间跳跃
content: 当剧情需要跳过较长时段（如数年）时，用一条字幕（如“SIX YEARS HAVE PASSED”）直接标示时间流逝，再接下一场。
quote: SUBTITLE: SIX YEARS HAVE PASSED.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 用近景表现内心戏
content: 当剧情需要靠面部表情传达人物心理（如两人互相猜忌）时，把摄影机移近演员，用近景/中近景取代全景，让表情成为叙事手段。
quote: The big scenes which were at the table when the men become distrustful of each other could be told only through facial expression.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 冷静台词配平静动作
content: 当台词内容冷静克制时，动作提示也用"非常平静地说"这类低强度修饰，让表演幅度与台词语气一致。
quote: Eve turns to look at him, and then says very calmly:

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 插入镜头切分
content: 当同一动作需要拆成两个镜头时，用插入镜头（close-up）切分，并在分镜中注明“To be cut into Scenes 33 and 34”。
quote: (To be cut into Scenes 33 and 34.)

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 为新技术冒险
content: 当旧拍法无法传达内容时，应主动尝试新机位/新景别，即使团队担心效果；不试新东西就永远无法进步。
quote: We’ll do it--we’ll never get anywhere if we don’t begin to try new things.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 直白台词配错愕反应
content: 当角色把话说得过于直白时，对手戏角色以"目瞪口呆"的反应承接，用反应强度反衬台词的冲击力。
quote: The doctor looks at her, flabbergasted at the plain way in which she is putting things.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 华丽制作加表演精湛
content: 影片以制作的华丽感为主调，同时必须与表演的精湛相结合，二者并重才能取得预期效果。
quote: Gorgeousness of production is the predominant key-note, associated with acting excellence

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 动作写在编号场次内
content: 影片全部动作都落在分镜剧本的编号场次中，演员的表演段落必然归属于一个或多个编号场次，读本时按场次定位自己的戏。
quote: All the action of a motion picture story is contained in the numbered scenes of the scenario.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 学拍片先研究银幕
content: 想学写电影剧本，最有效的办法是研究银幕：尽可能多看片，重要的片子反复看，并且带着分析去看。
quote: “Study the screen.”

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 生活体验反哺表演
content: 想让演员的银幕表现更有活力，应鼓励其接触人、书、娱乐与陌生场景；把全部精力只投入电影反而会削弱其可调用的生命力。
quote: Eagerly she turns to people, books, gaiety, strange scenes.

source_ref.title: Behind the Screen
source_ref.author: Goldwyn, Samuel, 1879-1974

title: 透射幕背投法
content: 想让画面在白天被路人看见，可用半透明幕置于观众与放映机之间做背投，画面可小至约24×30英寸仍清晰可见。
quote: the image being projected upon a translucent screen placed between the spectators and the projector

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 多面镜中心观看
content: 把多张画面装在水平轮内侧、中心置多面镜，观众可同时从多面镜中看到活动影像，实现多人共看。
quote: The several pictures were mounted on the inside of a horizontal wheel and were viewed on a polygonal-mirror in the center.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 摄影平台堵门
content: 把沉重的移动摄影平台正对摄影棚入口摆放，使平台完全堵住门；拍摄进行中到访者只能停在平台与门之间的几英尺空间内等待，直到该镜头拍完。
quote: for it completely blocked the entrance--was a heavy rolling platform on which the camera, poised atop of its tripod, was set.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 放大到银幕的投影构想
content: 把逐格装置的画面投到银幕上、放大到真人尺寸，供大量观众同时观看，是放映规模的关键目标。
quote: throw life-size figures from the Praxinoscope onto a screen before a large audience

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 银幕作为生活之镜
content: 把银幕当作映照生活的镜子来使用：画面内容应让观众从中获得对自身的认知，这是电影作为通用语言的核心价值，也是选材与呈现的取舍依据。
quote: The Value of the Screen as a Mirror of Life

source_ref.title: That Marvel—The Movie A Glance at Its Past, Its Promising Present and Its Significant Future
source_ref.author: Van Zile, Edward S. (Edward Sims), 1863-1931; Hays, Will H. (Will Harrison), 1879-1954 [Author of introduction, etc.]; Pyle, Howard, 1853-1911 [Illustrator]

title: 近景填满画面
content: 拍双人对峙时，可让桌子与两侧人物几乎填满整个画面，人物被放大后每个念头都清晰可见。
quote: a table with a man on each side filling up the whole screen, nearly.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 工业题材的浪漫化取景
content: 拍工业题材时取其浪漫面：把油田拍成黑色油湖、油桶倾泻等光滑反光的画面，而非只记录生产流程。
keywords: 工业题材的浪漫化取景
quote: we “took” plungers innumerable and expensive oil spilling out of huge barrels into little lakes, all black and smooth and shiny.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 用环境细节铺陈氛围
content: 拍摄历史/异域题材时，把羊剪毛、花饰户外礼拜堂、铁栅窗、橘树玫瑰庭院等具体生活场景逐一入镜，用环境细节堆出时代与地域氛围。
quote: What a wealth of atmosphere of beautiful old Spain, Camulos’s far-famed adobe offered!

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 小景别与近机位
content: 拍摄场景实际占用空间很小，一般宽约12至16英尺；摄影机通常推到离画面仅几英尺处，以便把演员拍得尽可能大。
quote: The scene itself occupies but a small space, generally about 12 or 16 feet in width. As a rule the camera is brought within a few feet of the picture

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 导演在机后口述指导
content: 拍摄时导演始终待在摄影机后方，用口头指令在镜头进行中实时引导演员表演。
quote: the directors are always behind the camera to guide their actors with spoken directions as the scene is made

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 滤色片只透本色光
content: 拍摄时每个滤色片只允许对应色光通过：红片只透红光，底片上只记录被摄体的红色调；绿片、紫片同理，各自记录绿、紫影调。
quote: only the red rays being permitted to pass through the screen to the film

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 从剧院借调舞台导演
content: 拍摄舞台剧改编影片时，从剧院聘请熟悉制作各环节技术的舞台监督/导演来执导，以保证场面调度与表演的舞台水准。
quote: eminent stage managers, versed in every phase of the technique of production, were obtained from the theatres

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 烟灰与烟用替代材料
content: 拍烟灰中精灵的放大镜头时，用稻草充当烟丝、蒸汽充当烟，避免真烟燃烧并便于演员在其中活动。
quote: The tobacco is straw and the smoke is steam.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 危险特技的机位距离
content: 拍马匹冲向镜头的特技时，可让马贴近摄影机以制造惊险感，但需控制到仅差几英寸的距离，兼顾刺激与安全。
quote: Miss Lawrence’s blond head just missed the camera by a few inches.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 威胁戏的机位调度
content: 持枪威胁的戏：先给门口缓开的动作，再让持枪者入画、关门，被威胁者快速转身，随后持枪者绕到身后搜身并回到正面站位，用走位变化维持张力。
quote: Black Jack steps stealthily into room, covering Carson with automatic, closes door. Carson quickly turns.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 开拍前先排练
content: 排练在布景搭建之前进行，作者与导演带演员先排演剧本，导演现场记录笔记，确定调度后再进入搭景与拍摄。
quote: Rehearsals are arranged before the scenery is built

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 排练时坐摄影台
content: 排练期间演员可随意坐在约六英尺见方的摄影机台上，非拍摄状态下不要求清场或保持机位周围净空。
quote: During rehearsals actors sat all over the camera stand--it was at least six feet square

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 插入文字要短
content: 插入的信件、电报等文字内容要简短；长信意味着要占用大量胶片长度，才能给观众足够时间读完。
quote: Make them brief; long letters mean many feet of film to give the audience time to read them.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 小动作不可喧宾夺主
content: 插入的过场小动作（business）不能重要到把观众注意力从主线情节上引开，其分量应低于主线冲突。
quote: However, don’t let such “business” be important enough to distract the attention from the main plot.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 台口尺寸与舞台高度
content: 搭建可拍戏的舞台时，台口取宽18英尺、高13英尺，舞台台面高出地面约8英尺，台下空间留作桥、活板等效果装置。
quote: with a proscenium opening measuring 18 feet in width by 13 feet in height. The stage level was about 8 feet above the ground

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 多余动作会被放大
content: 摄影机会捕捉并放大演员的每一个动作：舞台上不被注意的多余手势，在银幕上被放大数倍后立刻被观众看到，因此应删去与场景无关的一切动作与手势。
quote: An unnecessary gesture is not noticed on the stage. On the screen, enlarged many times, it is instantly noted.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 开机前反复排练
content: 摄影机转动前一寸之前必须反复排练；一旦开机就在消耗胶片，不完美即等于浪费或削弱成片。
quote: Rehearse, rehearse, rehearse, before the camera is turned an inch.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 实景地选景原则
content: 改编小说时优先选择与原著地理/文化描述相符的真实地点拍摄，以获得建筑、器物、服饰等自然氛围，而非在棚内搭景。
quote: For Camulos was one of the five homes accredited to the real Ramona that Mrs. Jackson picked for her fictional one.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 放映机须刚性减振底座
content: 放映机因传动持续振动，底座必须足够厚重以吸收振动；可用单根铁柱一侧装灯箱、另一侧装放映机，画面比其它支撑方式更稳。
quote: the mounting chosen must be of a sufficiently massive character to absorb all the vibration set up.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 无声片中的道具表意
content: 无声片里道具可承担叙事表意：如旧西班牙铸造的钟虽无声，仍以画面出现来暗示时间与信仰背景。
quote: Even bells that were cast in old Spain rang silently on the screen.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 单场景循环放映
content: 早期放映机可只投一个场景，靠同一画面反复循环放映来满足观众对活动影像的需求；预演时若做段落节奏参考，可用单镜头循环代替多镜头剪辑。
quote: Large screen motion pictures, even of but one scene, repeated over and over, represented a definite step on that road.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 静电废镜与重拍
content: 早期胶片拍摄中，静电会在画面上形成抖动白线，导致整条镜头作废、必须重拍；排期时应为同一镜头预留多次重拍的时间与演员档期。
quote: static, those jiggly white lines that sometimes danced and sometimes rained all over the film.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 三色分光轮转拍摄
content: 早期自然色彩摄影用旋转快门：红、绿、紫三色滤色片与三块不透明扇区交替排列，每透过一个色片曝光一格，随后不透明扇区遮光时抓片，把新感光面送到下一色片前，连续三格分别记录红、绿、紫三色影调。
quote: Thus the shutter was divided into six parts--three colour screens and three opaque sectors alternately.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 减少前景地面
content: 构图时压缩演员脚下的地面：只保留约一英尺前景、露出脚尖即可，把画面让给人物全身，避免大段地板占据画幅。
quote: just get in the actors’ feet--get the toes--one foot of foreground will do.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 歌剧演员转银幕需克制
content: 歌剧演员转拍电影时，不能照搬舞台式的外放表演；银幕表演的核心是情绪克制，靠暗示而非直接呈现情绪来取得效果。
quote: That which was art in opera was not art on the screen, where the secret of achievement is emotional restraint.

source_ref.title: Behind the Screen
source_ref.author: Goldwyn, Samuel, 1879-1974

title: 全景到近景的突破
content: 此前所有镜头都是全景（演员脚前留出数码地面）；要表现表情就必须放弃这种留地习惯，改用近景，二者不可兼得。
quote: every scene had been a long shot--that is, the floor--the carpet--the greensward--showed yards in front of the actors’ feet.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 台词前先写动作
content: 每句台词前先写角色的可见动作（如转身、走近、伸手、出门），再引出对白，使表演有明确的动作依据。
quote: Eve watches her mother go out, then turns to the doctor, goes to him, gives him her hand, and says very quietly:

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 强光放大面部缺陷
content: 水银灯等强光源配合放大镜头会把日光下不可见的细节（如唇上绒毛、痣）放大成怪相，因此布光与镜头选择需评估其对皮肤细节的放大效应。
quote: under the fierce mercury lights of the studio and the enlarging lenses they made her face grotesque

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 先定角色再合导演
content: 演员先自行把角色情绪与动机梳理清楚，之后才容易接受并贴合导演的想法；顺序是先自我准备、后服从导演调度。
quote: Once an actor has carefully worked out the part for himself he can easily conform to the director's ideas

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 上镜脸与真人之别
content: 现实中极具美貌或深具性格的脸，常常无法把这种特质传递到摄影机上；选角时须区分真人观感与上镜效果，不能只凭现实中的美貌或性格判断。
quote: The curious fact is that faces which in real life possess great beauty or deep character, frequently fail to carry this across to the camera.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 俯视镜头交代空间
content: 用从高处俯瞰的镜头（如从山脊俯视下方车站）交代两地点的空间关系，为后续人物下行或行动提供方位依据。
quote: Clearing on ridge; station can be seen below.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 穿孔带与卷盘供片
content: 用带齿孔的胶片带配合卷盘或片轴来输送画面，使连续长片段的商业放映成为可能。
quote: he was the first to introduce on a commercially practical basis reels or spools to handle the film

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 银幕表演要求绝对写实
content: 电影表演的基本前提是摄影机要求的写实度远高于舞台观众的眼睛：演员要像在自己家里一样自然、从容，表情幅度不超过真实生活中的程度，并完全忘掉摄影机的存在。
quote: The camera, however, demands absolute realism. Actors must act as naturally and as leisurely as they would in their own homes.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 暗场才是最佳观影
content: 画面最佳呈现条件是全黑或仅有极微弱红色余光；日光放映虽称减轻眼疲劳，但观众不买账，说明亮度妥协不可取。
quote: moving pictures can obviously be seen at their best only in total darkness or a very slight suffused red glow

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 上方灯反射照明
content: 画面照明由装置上方安装的灯经反射提供，光从上方打到画面再进入观看光路。
quote: Light was reflected from a lamp mounted above.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 透明胶片手绘上色
content: 画面绘制在透明赛璐珞片上，以便光线穿透投影；手绘逐格上色可让银幕画面获得色彩与层次。
quote: The scenes were painted on transparent celluloid

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 分色底片本身无彩色
content: 经三色分光拍出的底片显影后仍是黑白影像，本身不带任何色彩，只是三张连续画面的密度因各滤色片作用而不同。
quote: The developed film possesses no tinge of colour in itself. It is merely a black-and-white image.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: Sp 标记台词
content: 缩写“Sp”表示 Speech，说明其后的字幕内容需由演员说出。
quote: The abbreviation "Sp" means "Speech," indicating that the title which follows is to be spoken by the actor.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 齿孔输片与缓冲弯
content: 胶片由上方防火片盒经与齿孔啮合的齿轮拉出，齿轮之后留一个缓冲弯，以减轻片门处的拉力。
quote: a loop being provided to relieve it so that the pull will not be too great when passing through the film-gate

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 非大写引文为表演参考
content: 脚本中未用大写标出的引文不在银幕上显示，仅作为演员表演的参考指引。
keywords: 非大写引文为表演参考
quote: Some of the quoted lines--the ones not set off in capitals--are not shown on the screen, but are merely given as a guide for the players.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 彩虹幕做法
content: 自制高增益幕布：把白色材料浸鱼胶，再贴一层着色薄织物，形成所谓“彩虹幕”以增强日光下的可见度。
quote: prepared by soaking a suitable white material with fish glue and attaching thereto a thin layer of tinted fabric

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 舞台面积与双组并行
content: 舞台用平整木板铺成，面积要大到足以让两个摄制组同时开工；排布时按此容量规划机位与演员区，避免互相穿帮。
quote: The stage was of nice smooth boards and seemed almost big enough for two companies to work at the same time.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 普通光源即可放映
content: 若投影装置光路效率足够，可用普通台灯作光源，不必依赖专用强光源。
quote: no special light source was required. A common table lamp was suitable.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 异地补拍
content: 若演员已随组转场，仍可让导演与摄影师带摄影机赶赴演员所在地补拍同一镜头，以保证素材完整。
quote: the movie director and his camera man were right there in Washington!

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 日光放映的亮度取舍
content: 若要在半亮环境（剧院半数灯亮）放映，需把放映机放远（约66英尺）、画面缩小（约10×8英尺）、弧灯电流加大（110V电路取30安培），以亮度换环境光容忍度。
quote: the projector being 66 feet from the screen, the size of the picture being 10 by 8 feet, and the arc lamp taking normally a current of 30 amperes

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 背投隐藏放映机
content: 若要让观众看不到放映设备，把放映机藏在舞台银幕后方，采用背面投影，使画面从幕布背面投出。
quote: Rear projection was used with the apparatus concealed on the theatre stage behind the screen.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 叠化表现回忆
content: 表现人物回忆或今昔对比时，用叠化或双重曝光把当前沉思姿态与过去场景（如荡秋千）叠合，而非硬切。
quote: Carson in reflective attitude. Dissolve, or a double exposure of--

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 用反应动作表现震惊
content: 表现角色被话语击中时，写其后退两三步、愣住、惊讶地注视对方，用身体位移与停顿替代台词传达情绪。
quote: The doctor, taken aback, steps back a couple of steps, looks at her in astonishment

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 讥讽用微笑外化
content: 表现讥讽或怜悯时，写角色带着怜悯看他、露出讥讽的微笑，再开口说台词，用面部表情先于台词传递态度。
quote: Eve looks at him commiseratingly, smiles a cynical smile, and says:

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 可逆放映做倒放效果
content: 装置可正反双向运行时，可让角色倒着动作，制造滑稽、新奇的喜剧效果，作为早期特技放映手段。
quote: his apparatus was fully reversible and at times he would create novel and hilarious effects by making the characters jump backwards

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 无片盘只能单场景
content: 装置没有卷片盘处理片带时，一次只能放映一个场景，无法连续切换多段内容。
quote: only one scene at a time could be shown in the device for it had no reels to handle the band of glass slides.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 用场景呼应表现思念
content: 要让观众知道远方的角色仍心系某人，可安排一场与开场相同地点的告别/回忆场景（如同一农家庭院）来呼应。
quote: The author desires to show us that, though he is far away in the wilderness, Carson’s thoughts are still true to Mary.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 长胶片连续放映
content: 要连续放映多个场景而非单一画面，应使用长条涂布胶片代替圆盘排列的图片，这是早期能处理多场景的放映机方案。
quote: using long strips of coated celluloid film instead of pictures set on a disk

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 写实再现的驱动力
content: 观众对影像的根本诉求是自然、写实地再现生活；因此镜头设计优先追求真实感与生活化再现，而非装饰性画面。
quote: Man from the beginning sought to recreate life naturally and realistically.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 用字幕下命令
content: 角色下达关键指令时，用字幕（SUBTITLE）直接呈现台词，随后接执行动作的镜头。
quote: SUBTITLE: “STICK OUT A RED FOR NO. 2 AT WIND RIVER.”

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 重复动作做喜剧
content: 让同一角色在不同场次重复同一习惯动作（如边走边看书、火柴烧到手指），用重复与意外（烫手、绊倒）制造喜剧节奏。
quote: Call-boy reading novel and lighting lantern without taking eyes off book. Match burning fingers.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 暗示优于直给
content: 设计表演与镜头时，让演员通过暗示（suggesting）传达情绪，而不是把情绪完整呈现（presenting）出来；可参考卓别林的做法。
quote: he gets his effects by suggesting rather than by presenting an emotion.

source_ref.title: Behind the Screen
source_ref.author: Goldwyn, Samuel, 1879-1974

title: 玻璃幻灯片带供片
content: 连续动作画面可画在玻璃幻灯片上并连成一条带子，逐格通过投影装置，形成连续放映。
quote: The designs were colored on glass slides which were joined in a band.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 选角按类型征召
content: 选角导演按分镜要求的“类型”发出征召，尽量直接通知演员，否则通过经纪机构联系。
quote: The casting director immediately sends out a call for the "types" demanded in the scenario.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 密度差形成影像
content: 银幕上的画面由胶片上各点对光的遮挡程度决定，即按影像密度比例阻光而成像。
quote: The pictures are outlined on the screen because of the fact that the figures on the film obstruct light in proportion to their density.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 银幕演员需各角度皆美
content: 银幕演员必须在任何表情、任何角度下都同样好看，因为重要场面总以特写拍摄，愤怒、痛苦、爱、恨等情绪下都要保持魅力，否则会给观众留下长期负面印象。
quote: A screen star should be equally beautiful in every expression and from every angle.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 轮廓比五官精细更重要
content: 银幕美感不取决于五官的精细与肤色，而取决于面部轮廓；轮廓粗犷但结构好的脸，上镜效果常与五官精致者相当，选角时应优先看骨相轮廓。
quote: Considerations which do not matter in the slightest degree in facial beauty on the screen are those of coloring and of fineness of the features.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 准备与自我暗示
content: 银幕表演的两条心理技巧：一是Preparation（开拍前研读并真实感受角色情绪），二是Auto-Suggestion（自我暗示）；二者决定是"真表演"还是"例行公事"。
quote: The first is that of Preparation; the second, that of Auto-Suggestion.

source_ref.title: Breaking into the movies
source_ref.author: Emerson, John, 1874-1956; Loos, Anita, 1893-1981

title: 字幕嵌入动作
content: 需要交代关键信息（如反派计划）时，把字幕写成剧中人物的台词并放在该场动作进行中，不要用作者旁白式字幕放在场前或场后，否则力度明显减弱。
quote: Note the strength gained by inserting the subtitle in the action of the scene and having it a speech by one of the characters.

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 双灯分层放映
content: 需要同时呈现背景与运动主体时，用两台光学系统分工：一台幻灯机投固定背景，另一台专投运动画面，在银幕上叠合成完整场景。
quote: one magic lantern provided the background and another optical system which handled the moving film cast the motion effects onto the screen

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 双灯分层投影法
content: 需要同时呈现背景与运动主体时，用两台灯：一台灯投背景，另一台灯经运动装置投活动影像，使人物在背景上运动。
quote: One lantern threw the background and the moving device projected the motion pictures.

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 特写推进情节
content: 需要展示关键物件（地图、桌面）时，切到特写镜头，让观众看清角色在找什么、做什么。
quote: _Close-up of desk._

source_ref.title: A-B-C of motion pictures
source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 顶部轨道柔光布
content: 需要柔化日光时，把 muslin 柔光布挂在头顶的轨道（trolley）系统上，可随太阳角度移动布位来调节光比，而不是靠灯位调整。
quote: The muslin light diffusers were operated on an overhead trolley system.

source_ref.title: When the movies were young
source_ref.author: Arvidson, Linda, 1884-1949

title: 灵感型表演不可催
content: 需要演员给出最佳银幕表演时，不能靠催促或按固定日程逼出灵感；最佳表演本质上是灵感性的，应给演员留出等待状态到来的空间，而非像点单一样要求按时产出。
quote: Such an expectation is as vain as the belief that you could obtain a poet’s best work by snapping your fingers over him

source_ref.title: Behind the Screen
source_ref.author: Goldwyn, Samuel, 1879-1974

title: 用长镜头交代距离
content: 需要让观众感到角色走了很远时，用一段较长的行程镜头（如列车行进）来表现，避免用突兀的字幕直接说明。
quote: The long tickets let the spectator know that Carson is going a great distance, without the necessity of an abrupt subtitle stating the fact.

source_ref.author: Welsh, Robert E. (Robert Emmet), 1893-1964; Frohman, Daniel, 1851-1940 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 定日镜稳定光斑
content: 需要长时间稳定照明时，可用机械驱动的反射镜（定日镜）补偿地球运动，把太阳光持续聚焦在同一位置，避免光斑漂移。
quote: is simply a mechanically driven reflector which keeps the light of the sun focused on a single spot by compensating for the movement of the earth

source_ref.title: Magic Shadows: The Story of the Origin of Motion Pictures
source_ref.author: Quigley, Martin, 1917-2011; Curtis, Edward Peck, 1897-1987 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 摄影机置于小屋
content: 露天拍摄时把摄影机与操作员安置在小屋内，以遮蔽光线与天气对设备的影响。
quote: The camera and operator were accommodated in the small hut.

source_ref.title: Moving Pictures: How They Are Made and Worked
source_ref.author: Talbot, Frederick Arthur Ambrose, 1880-1924

title: 冲动型演员不预判时刻
content: 面对冲动型演员，不要让其提前计算某个时刻该怎么演，因为临场可能产生更好的选择；应把决定权留给现场瞬间，而非事先锁死表演方案。
quote: She never calculates the moment ahead for fear that the moment itself might calculate something she liked better.

source_ref.title: Behind the Screen
source_ref.author: Goldwyn, Samuel, 1879-1974

title: 色彩在黑白片中失效
content: 黑白胶片不记录色彩明度关系：红色拍出来发黑，因此脸颊越红润在画面上反而显得越凹陷；选角与打光时不能依赖肤色红润，应按明暗对比判断上镜效果。
quote: The pinker a woman's cheeks may be, the hollower they appear to the camera, for red photographs as black
